recent_en: K-One Technology held an EGM on 30 September 2026 where shareholders approved the RM94,000,000 cash disposal of its entire stake in G-AsiaPacific and a RM46,000,000 capital reduction and repayment. On 6 November 2026, the sale and purchase agreement became unconditional and the disposal was deemed completed, paving the way for the capital repayment. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 41.4% QoQ and net profit turned positive.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the RM94,000,000 cash disposal of the entire stake in G-AsiaPacific at the EGM on 30 September 2026.
Shareholders approved the RM46,000,000 capital reduction and repayment.
The SPA for the disposal became unconditional on 6 November 2026 and the disposal was deemed completed.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 69,229,000, up 41.4% QoQ and 7.3% YoY; net profit was MYR 433,000 with a net margin of 0.6%, up 35.3% YoY from the prior year, while the previous quarter's net margin was -5.3%.
